opportunities.title: Regular Grants (Operating/Core Costs, Projects, Capital)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations, exempt or excepted organisations (per Charity Commission guidelines); must have at least one year of audited or independently examined accounts; organisations must work inside the UK or UK Overseas Territories; organisations that have received a grant or been declined within the past year are not eligible to apply again until a year has passed.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for operating/core costs, specific projects and capital projects. Local community capital projects (e.g., church or village hall) are typically funded up to £30,000. Applications are submitted via the Foundation’s online Grants Portal on a rolling basis.

opportunities.title: Major Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations, exempt or excepted organisations; must have annual income of at least £1 million for core‑cost grants, or propose a project/capital cost of at least £1 million; must have audited or independently examined accounts; work must be based in the UK or UK Overseas Territories; cannot have received a grant from the Foundation within the previous year.
opportunities.summary: For organisations seeking funding of £1 million or more. Core‑cost major grants require the organisation’s annual income to be £1 million or above. Project or capital major grants require the total cost of the proposed work to be at least £1 million. Interested applicants express interest via an Expression of Interest form on the Grants Management Portal; the process is open year‑round.
